potential_clients.summary: Sohib Boundaoui has held two discussions with Jorge O from City Dental Studio about replacing their expensive $10,000 monthly Zocdoc dependency with Flow Company's integrated marketing service at $3,500 per month. The practice has strong fundamentals with 5-star ratings and 435 reviews, currently ranks for 41 keywords, but lacks paid advertising and needs to expand local SEO reach into markets like Pembroke Pines. Flow's proposal includes comprehensive marketing channels, CRM integration with their existing Weave and Open Dental systems, automated lead recovery capturing 30% of missed opportunities, and $1,500 to $2,000 monthly ad spend targeting 10 new patients by month three. The conversations have progressed toward internal review with Dr. Gabrielle Beckoff and the practice team before moving forward.
